start: Registered in the workspace .mcp.json as 'blender-live' (uv run --script tools/blender-live/server.py, cwd = workspace root). Reload MCP servers in the client. Call blender_launch(blend_path) to open Blender with the bridge, or start Blender yourself with: blender.exe FILE.blend --python tools/blender-live/bridge.py
binding: The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1:9876 (BLENDER_LIVE_PORT). Only one bridged Blender per port. Blender is found from BLENDER_EXE, else a one-line blender_exe.txt beside server.py, else `blender` on PATH. Capture files go to BLENDER_LIVE_TMP, default .scratch/tmp/blender-live/<pid>/ in the workspace.
architecture: bridge.py runs inside GUI Blender: a socket thread queues newline-delimited JSON requests, a persistent bpy.app.timers pump executes them on Blender's main thread (bpy is not thread-safe). server.py is a FastMCP stdio server that forwards tool calls to the bridge, and runs headless Blender jobs itself.
verification: Every feature below lists the smoke checks that prove it (tools/blender-live/smoke_test.py over real MCP stdio, results in .scratch/blender-live-smoke/smoke.json 'checks'). A claim without a passing check is not listed.

launch.claim: blender_launch starts GUI Blender on the given .blend with the bridge and waits until it answers; a second call while a bridge answers starts nothing.

status.claim: blender_status returns version, open file, dirty flag, scene, frame range, active camera and object count.

inspect.claim: scene_tree lists the scene's collections and objects; object_info returns transform, world bounds and camera lens for a camera.

exec_python.claim: exec_python runs code in the live session and returns `result` and stdout; capture=True adds a viewport image taken right after the edit.

viewport_capture.claim: viewport_capture returns an image of the 3D viewport through a named camera or an axis view, also while the Blender window is minimized; the viewport's own overlay setting is restored afterwards.

motion_preview.claim: motion_preview returns one image per requested frame, in order, and puts the scene back on its previous frame.

render_image.claim: render_image renders a still at the requested size and engine and restores engine, resolution, percentage, output path and camera afterwards.

files_and_time.claim: save_file(filepath) saves a copy and the session continues on that copy; open_file opens a .blend; set_frame sets the scene frame.

headless_run.claim: headless_run runs a script in background Blender and returns the exit code and marker lines (an UPPERCASE word followed by a JSON object).

sculpt.claim: sculpt_begin picks a mesh and symmetry axis; sculpt_strokes moves vertices directly (grab, snake_hook, draw, clay_strips, inflate, crease, smooth) and reports moved_verts, max_move and mean_move per stroke; a stroke that misses reports 0 and does not error; symmetric strokes stay symmetric, also across the centre line; it works while the window is minimized.

sculpt_remesh.claim: sculpt_remesh voxel-remeshes to one closed part and refuses voxel sizes small enough to freeze Blender.

sculpt_mask.claim: sculpt_mask box protects vertices from strokes; clear unprotects them.

sculpt_relax.claim: sculpt_relax smooths a whole mesh: laplacian along Z irons stacked-ring ripples, taubin keeps the size, bad factors are refused.

fit_outline.claim: fit_outline warps the model's outline toward a reference outline in the picture plane after registering it, raising outline_match's overlap.

project_paint.claim: project_paint projects straight-on reference pictures onto every visible mesh's UVs with depth-buffer occlusion and gives each a flat emission material showing the image.

visual_match.claim: visual_match passes a painted smooth model on outline IoU, SSIM, interior edge F1, CIEDE2000 colour proof (with reference inks as hex) and clay banding, and fails a rippled model under the same paint on clay banding.

orbit_check.claim: orbit_check captures every azimuth step at each elevation, scores clay banding and missing textures per angle and returns a review sheet.

three_quarter_check.claim: three_quarter_check paints each reference picture on its own, renders the angle halfway between two neighbouring pictures with each, and passes where both show the same colours on the same surfaces (CIEDE2000 per head/body/legs region) and fails where they put them on different surfaces.

reference_and_turnaround.claim: reference_setup creates a REF_<VIEW> image empty at the requested height; turnaround_sheet returns one labelled image with a cell per view and a reference cell after each referenced view, hides the reference empties in the captures, and restores the viewport.

compare_images.claim: compare_images returns exact-pixel %, within-8 %, mean absolute error and SSIM plus a reference | candidate | difference image.

parity: PARITY.md maps every unreal-live tool to its blender-live equivalent.
lessons: subprocess DETACHED_PROCESS made Windows Blender start on an unsaved file (the .blend argument was lost); a new process group alone works.
screen.screenshot_area returned a 1x1 image when the Blender window was not being drawn; render.opengl(view_context=True) with a VIEW_3D context override does not depend on the window.
A headless Blender child that inherits the MCP server's stdin can hang; pass stdin=DEVNULL.
Relative output paths passed to Blender renders do not resolve against the caller's cwd; pass absolute paths.
bpy.app is read-only; keep run-once flags in bpy.app.driver_namespace.

A scripted bpy.ops.sculpt.brush_stroke from the bridge timer crashed Blender 4.5.16 (after its poll passed with a full VIEW_3D override and builtin.brush active; OperatorStrokeElement has no pen_flip in 4.5). Sculpt strokes therefore move vertices directly with numpy.
